_metadata.title: Editorial difficulty tags for retained hints (subjective)
_metadata.by: claude-session, after the owner's first playtest note on beta-01-001 (Hardcore, won, no lives lost: "basic, a little easy")
_metadata.what: A rough, explicitly SUBJECTIVE guess at how immediate each hint feels to a general US player: easy = the link lands at once; medium = a second look or a second sense; challenging = a clever, less immediate connection that still lands cleanly. Not a mechanic, not a threshold, not used by any script. Difficulty settings keep their meaning (Hardcore = 3 extra cards), never harder clue content. For a later mix decision by the owner/parent after more plays.
